description: This file defines the MailMessage class, which extends the Symfony Mime Email class, providing methods to configure email message properties such as subject, from, to, body, cc, and bcc. It appears to be a utility class for constructing email messages within the OrangeHRM HRM system, referencing internal Mail entity and Symfony MIME classes.

classes.name: MailMessage
classes.description: A class extending Symfony's Email class, adding convenience methods for setting email properties with support for text and HTML content types, as well as setting recipients, sender, subject, and body.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new MailMessage instance with a specified content type, defaulting to HTML.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender's email addresses with optional names.

methods.name: setMailBody
methods.description: Sets the email body as either plain text or HTML depending on the content type.
